TEXT: The match with fairy-san ended.

Kuroneko said she wanted to change her clothes, 
so she headed home for now.

We decided to meet up afterwards, at the school's 
backyard.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...Sorry for making you wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That outfit...

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
I thought such clothes would be good every so 
often... H-How is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's pretty cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It totally fits you.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...I-I see. Thank you.
For some reason, both of us just went silent.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, hey.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [font_size=26]Y[/font_size]-Yes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I forgot to tell you. Congratulations. That was a 
great game back there.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT: Hahahahaha! I lost, I lost! I got annihilated!

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
To think that even I could lose. Bravo. The title of 
World's Strongest is now yours, Angel-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: No... If it came down to true skill, I would've lost.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
Actually, I thought so too. I completely misjudged 
you.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
You used to be fixated on winning with elegance in 
our past matches, but now you focus on power.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
It's unfitting of your former self. A rather unrefined 
way of winning. You even went as far as to use the 
strongest character mercilessly.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
I was determined to win, no matter what... So I just 
put my best effort.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
Indeed. A firm resolution. Heh, I don't know what 
kind of wish you have in mind but... do your best.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
You have bested me, so I won't tolerate any 
half-heartedness.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
"I will show you that I can win even against God", 
wasn't that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That was cool.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Do you remember? The first time we went to 
Summer Comiket together.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...Of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You entered the Siscaly event for Kirino's sake, 
didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Back then, you were really cool too.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
...What's with this, all of a sudden? Flattery will get 
you nowhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You said it yourself, didn't you? If you won the 
battle with that person, you had something to tell 
me.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Y-Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Can you hear me out first?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I love you. Please go out with me.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...Yes.
And thus...
Kuroneko and I became lovers.
